Bramble Meridian Beginner Stat Guide

Game: Bramble Meridian. In Bramble Meridian, survivability improves when health is increased before offensive attributes.

Improve survivability first, then raise dexterity and endurance for equipment requirements and comfortable dodging. Equipment progression prioritizes upgrades with available materials before spreading attribute points too widely. Preserve health by returning to camp before supplies run low.
